protocol.projection: arithmetic mean along all axial samples, ZYX axis=0
protocol.orientation: XY, matching official BMP; transpose of old YX display
protocol.coverage: 256 center crop after lateral resize to 400; 64% lateral FOV per axis
protocol.metrics: prediction vs GT on identical crop, raw normalized [0,1]; SSIM win_size=7
protocol.display: common GT min-to-P99 window for GT/prediction; official BMP kept in its supplied display scale
protocol.official_crop: official BMP linearly resized and center-cropped only for visual alignment; not a metric target
